# Innoledge International Ltd

> Hong Kong-based business development partner (since the 1990s) for European and Japanese companies in Health, Cosmetics and Agro-Food, offering marketing, sourcing, investment, regulatory affairs, business consultancy and exclusive distribution in China, Hong Kong, Japan and Asia. Offices: Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, Tokyo. Tel +852 2803 7784, info@innoledge.com.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://innoledge.com/): company overview, services, sectors, partner brands
- [Our Services](https://innoledge.com/service.html): Marketing, Sourcing, Investment, Regulatory Affairs, Business Consultancy, Distribution
- [Our Portfolio](https://innoledge.com/our-portfolio/): medicines, medical devices, cosmetics, health food supplements, animal health
- [Rafaelo® Procedure in Hong Kong](https://innoledge.com/rafaelo-hong-kong/): patient information on the Rafaelo® radiofrequency haemorrhoid treatment (F Care Systems, Belgium); Innoledge is the exclusive Hong Kong distributor. Also in [Traditional Chinese](https://innoledge.com/zh/rafaelo-hong-kong/) and [French](https://innoledge.com/fr/rafaelo-hong-kong/).
- [About Us](https://innoledge.com/about-us/): founder Dr Bruno Leraillez
- [Contact](https://innoledge.com/contact-us/)

## Partner brands represented in Asia
- F Care Systems (Belgium): Rafaelo® procedure, MedRF4000® radiofrequency generator
- Precilens (France): orthokeratology lenses for myopia control
- Global Healthcare Network: pharmaceutical products
- Amino Eclipse (Japan): amino-acid supplements for racehorses
- Arthro Guard 300: avocado & soy unsaponifiable joint health supplement
- Argile du Velay (France): natural green clay care
- COSMETiGATE: cosmetics
- Francine (Japan): feminine hygiene

English (default), French (/fr/), Traditional Chinese (/zh/).
